description: This file defines an internal utility class RuntimeHelpers with a method GetSubArray, used to support newer C# features such as range slicing in environments that do not natively support them. It is based on code from the .NET source and is conditionally compiled for .NET Standard / Framework versions below .NET 6.0.

classes.name: RuntimeHelpers
classes.description: A static internal class providing a helper method GetSubArray for slicing arrays with Range objects in older .NET versions.

methods.name: GetSubArray
methods.description: Returns a subarray sliced from the input array based on the provided Range object. Supports arrays of reference types and value types, with special handling for null elements and empty ranges.
